library.name: xterm.js
library.description: Terminal emulator for the device consoles.

library.name: xterm.js addon-fit
library.description: Fits the terminal to its container.

library.name: noVNC
library.description: RFB (VNC) client for the graphical consoles of QEMU nodes. The npm package @novnc/novnc 1.7.0 bundled into one ES module with esbuild 0.28.2 (plugin/devtools/build_novnc.mjs). Customised: the only change is one line while bundling, the top-level await in core/util/browser.js (it breaks the Babel step of grunt amd) became a promise that sets the same variable. The notices of the parts below are in the header of the file.

library.name: pako (inside noVNC)
library.description: zlib inflate and deflate, vendor/pako of noVNC (an ES module port of pako 1.0.3). Part of the noVNC bundle.

library.name: DES (inside noVNC)
library.description: DES for VNC password authentication, core/crypto/des.js of noVNC: ported from Flashlight VNC, which took it from Acme.Crypto and Dave Zimmerman's DesCipher. BSD-style terms, the full attribution is in the header of the file. Part of the noVNC bundle.
